scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w backend && npm run test:coverage -w frontend
scripts.build:quality: npm run build -w frontend -- --mode quality && npm run build -w backend
scripts.quality:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:quality && npm run test:coverage && npm run eval:ai && npm run coverage:check
